name: Regular Meeting of the City Council
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE ARTESIA CITY COUNCIL

  ALBERT O. LITTLE COMMUNITY CENTER
  18750 CLARKDALE AVENUE
  ARTESIA, CA 90701 – (562) 865-6262

  MONDAY, DECEMBER 9, 2019
  7:00 P.M.

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

INVOCATION – PASTOR LOUIE PEREZ, THE WELL CHURCH

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE – ARTESIA ROYAL COURT

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING SPEAKER CARDS

Anyone wishing to speak to the City Council should fill out a speaker card and give that
card to the City Clerk at the staff table prior to the commencement of the meeting. Please
observe a time limit of three (3) minutes when giving your presentation.

PUBLIC COMMENTS ON ITEMS THAT ARE NOT ON THE AGENDA OR ITEMS
LISTED UNDER THE HEADING CONSENT CALENDAR

This time is for members of the public to address the Councilmembers on items that are
not listed on the agenda. Any public comments that cannot be heard within the next 20
minutes will be heard at the end of the meeting. If a member of the public wishes to speak
on a Consent Calendar item, the item will be removed from the Consent Calendar for
separate discussion and to allow the member of the public to speak on the Consent
Calendar item at that time. Under the provisions of the Brown Act, the City Council is
prohibited from taking action on items that are not listed on the agenda, but may refer the
matter to staff or to a subsequent meeting.

COUNCILMEMBER COMMENTS

This is the time for general comments, announcements, and requests of staff and/or
other issues of concern to Councilmembers that may briefly be presented at this time.

REORGANIZATION PROGRAM

1.  CITY COUNCIL REORGANIZATION SELECTION OF MAYOR

  Page 1 of 2
  2.  CITY COUNCIL REORGANIZATION SELECTION OF MAYOR PRO TEM

 3.  INCOMING MAYOR’S COMMENTS

ADDITIONAL PUBLIC COMMENTS
This time is set-aside for the public to address the City Council on any item of interest
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the City Council that could not be heard under
public comment section at the beginning of the meeting.

COUNCILMEMBER COMMENTS
This is the time for additional general comment, announcements, and requests of staff
and/or other issues of concern to Councilmembers that may briefly be presented at this
time.

  ADJOURNMENT TO
  ADJOURNED REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  OF DECEMBER 10, 2019, AT 7:00 P.M.
The City of Artesia complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require special assistance to attend or participate
in this meeting, please call the City Clerk’s office at 562-865-6262 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting. Copies of Staff Reports are
on file in the Office of the City Clerk and are available for inspection. Anyone who requires audio assistance to listen to these
proceedings may request the use of an assistive listening device (ALD) from the City Clerk. If you require said device, please come
forward to the City Clerk at the staff table for assistance.

CITY OF ARTESIA
  ALBERT O. LITTLE COMMUNITY CENTER
  18750 CLARKDALE AVENUE, ARTESIA, CA 90701

  REGULAR MEETING OF THE ARTESIA CITY COUNCIL

  MONDAY, DECEMBER 9, 2019
  7:00P.M.
The Regular Meeting of the Artesia City Council was called to order at 7:00 p.m., on Monday,
December 9, 2019 in the Albert O. Little Community Center by Mayor Tony Lima. The Invocation
was presented by Pastor Louie Perez, The Well Church. The Pledge of Allegiance was led by the
Artesia Royal Court.

 PRESENT:  Melissa Ramoso, Councilmember
  Rene Trevino, Councilmember
  Ali Taj, Councilmember
  Miguel Canales, Mayor Pro Tem
  Tony Lima, Mayor

 ALSO PRESENT:  William Rawlings, City Manager
  Christi Hogin, City Attorney
  Ernesto Sanchez, City Clerk
  Jamie Murguia, Assistance City Clerk
  Melissa Burke, Administrative Manager
  Siamlu Cox, Acting Finance Manager

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

  MOTION BY COUNCILMEMBER TAJ TO APPROVE THE AGENDA.

  MOTION SECONDED BY MAYOR LIMA.

  CITY COUNCIL ACTION: The Agenda was approved without objection 5-0-0.

ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING SPEAKER CARDS

  City Clerk presented the announcement.

PUBLIC COMMENTS ON ITEMS THAT ARE NOT ON THE AGENDA OR ITEMS LISTED
UNDER THE HEADING CONSENT CALENDAR

  The City Clerk reported that there were no public comments were received.

COUNCILMEMBER COMMENTS

  Councilmember Taj provided comments.

  Councilmember Ramoso provided comments.

  Councilmember Trevino provided comments.

  Page 1 of 3
   Mayor Pro Tem Canales provided comments.

  Mayor Lima provided comments.

REORGANIZATION PROGRAM

  1. CITY COUNCIL REORGANIZATION SELECTION OF MAYOR

  Mayor Lima opened nomination period for Mayor Elect among Councilmembers.

  Councilmember Ramoso nominated Mayor Pro Tem Canales for Mayor Elect.

  Mayor Lima closed the nomination period for Mayor Elect among Councilmembers

  MOTION BY COUNCILMEMBER RAMOSO TO ELECT MAYOR PRO TEM CANALES
  AS MAYOR.

  AYES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  Ramoso, Canales
  NOES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  Trevino, Taj, Lima
  ABSTAIN:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
  ABSENT:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None

  CITY COUNCIL ACTION: No Action. Motion did not pass 2-3-0-0.

  City Attorney provided the City Council with direction.

  Mayor Lima reopened nomination period for Mayor Elect among Councilmembers.

  Councilmember Trevino nominated Councilmember Taj for Mayor Elect.

  Mayor Lima closed the nomination period for Mayor Elect among Councilmembers

  MOTION BY COUNCILMEMBER TREVINO TO ELECT COUNCILMEMBER TAJ AS
  MAYOR ELECT.

  AYES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  Trevino, Taj, Canales, Lima
  NOES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
  ABSTAIN:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  Ramoso
  ABSENT:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None

  CITY COUNCIL ACTION: Councilmember Taj was elected Mayor 4-0-1-0

  2. CITY COUNCIL REORGANIZATION SELECTION OF MAYOR PRO TEM

  Mayor Taj opened nomination period for Mayor Pro Tem Elect among Councilmembers.

  Councilmember Lima nominated Councilmember Trevino for Mayor Pro Tem Elect.

  Mayor Taj closed the nomination period for Mayor Pro Tem Elect among Councilmembers.

  Page 2 of 3
   MOTION BY COUNCILMEMBER LIMA TO ELECT COUNCILMEMBER TREVINO AS
  MAYOR PRO TEM ELECT.

  AYES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  Ramoso, Canales, Trevino, Lima, Taj
  NOES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
  ABSTAIN:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
  ABSENT:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None

  CITY COUNCIL ACTION: Councilmember Trevino was elected Mayor Pro Tem without
  objection 5-0-0-0.

  3. INCOMING MAYOR’S COMMENTS

  Mayor Taj provided comments.

ADDITIONAL PUBLIC COMMENTS

  There were no additional public comments.

COUNCILMEMBER COMMENTS

  Councilmember Lima provided comments.

  Councilmember Ramoso provided comments.

  Councilmember Canales provided comments.

  Mayor Pro Tem Trevino provided comments.

  Mayor Taj provided comments.

ADJOURNMENT

  Mayor Taj adjourned the meeting at 7:42 pm.

  Page 3 of 3
